title: anchoredRegexPattern's anchor wrap is blanked, reopening #1741's stream-selector over-match
notes: Blanks anchoredRegexPattern's anchorPrefix/anchorSuffix constants (internal/chsql/builder.go:847-848) from "^(?:" / ")$" to "", reopening issue #1741: job=~"ap" (or, here, LogQL's env=~"prod|stg" stream selector) would again match "production" as a substring instead of rejecting it, since ClickHouse's match() is a substring search and Prometheus/Loki/Tempo regex matchers are always fully anchored. Scoped to the label-matcher path deliberately: anchoredRegexPattern is called only from chplan.OpMatch/OpNotMatch sites (internal/chsql/builder.go's exprBinary and exprNestedArrayExists) — LogQL line filters (`|~`/`!~` against the log line) lower to a distinct chplan.LineContent node in internal/logql/lower.go's lineFilterPart and never call this function, so their already-unanchored (Loki-correct) substring semantics are untouched by this mutation, preserving the stream-selector/line-filter distinction the grounding issue calls out. THIS MUTATION IS NOT LOGQL-ONLY: anchoredRegexPattern is the one SQL-emission site chplan.OpMatch/OpNotMatch shares across PromQL, LogQL and TraceQL (see LOGQL-LABEL-MATCHER-REGEX-ANCHORING's and PROMQL-LABEL-MATCHER-REGEX-ANCHORING's own blind_spots, and the cross-head SIGNAL-LABEL-MATCHER-CONSISTENCY contract) — the primary detector is the LogQL fixture (test/spec/logql/stream_regex_no_overmatch.txtar, the regression fixture #1741 itself added), and the second detector is PromQL's own regression twin (test/spec/promql/regex_unanchored_no_overmatch.txtar) included as SUPPLEMENTARY, disclosed evidence of the same shared-emitter blast radius rather than a second independent bug — both are expected to report killed for the identical root cause, not two uncorrelated findings. Both detectors share test/spec's generic spec.Walk/spec.Match golden-comparison harness (structural sql/args/chplan text diffing) — that harness is head-agnostic plumbing, not part of either head's own independent evidence; what differs per detector is the head-specific Lower() entry point and its own fixture corpus. Neither detector needs the chdb build tag or a live ClickHouse: the kill is a static sql/args/chplan text mismatch against the golden, verified before chDB round-trip execution is even reached (see internal/logql/lower_test.go's TestLower and internal/promql/lower_test.go's TestLower, both gated on no build tag). Independent real-Loki confirmation that the CONTROL behavior (anchored, no over-match) matches reference Loki lives in compatibility/loki/cerberus-queries/regression/anchored-regex-matcher.yaml, run via `just compat-logql` — that lane cannot itself execute against a mutated overlay (it needs a live docker-compose Loki + ClickHouse stack, not go test -overlay), so it is evidence for the control's correctness, not a third mutation detector.
